title: CLI "deckent web" Command
description:
CLI "deckent web" Command
- Create src/cli/commands/web.ts with registerWeb(program: Command)
- Command: deckent web [--port 3100] [--dev]
  - --port: API server port (default 3100)
  - --dev: prints instruction "Run 'cd src/dashboard && npm run dev' for Vite dev server on port 5173"
  - Without --dev: serves built dashboard from src/dashboard/dist/ as static files
    - Any request NOT starting with /api/ → try static file from dist, fallback to index.html (SPA routing)
    - MIME type map: .html → text/html, .js → application/javascript, .css → text/css, .svg → image/svg+xml, .json → application/json
  - Starts API server via createHttpServer(), prints "Deckent Web Dashboard on http://localhost:{port}"
  - SIGINT/SIGTERM → graceful shutdown
- Modify createHttpServer() signature: add optional staticDir parameter for static file serving
- Register in src/cli/index.ts: import registerWeb, call registerWeb(program)
- Create tests/cli/web.test.ts with mocked fs/http
- Dosya: src/cli/commands/web.ts, src/api/server.ts, src/cli/index.ts, tests/cli/web.test.ts
- Kapsam: src/cli/commands/, src/cli/index.ts, tests/cli/, src/api/server.ts
